articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single unified model, and a 1M-token context window. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap with specialized domain tools.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Model Enables Dexterous Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Robotics, a foundation model that directly maps visual and tactile sensor inputs to fine-grained motor commands for robotic hands. In warehouse trials with partner companies, the system achieved a 94% grasp success rate on previously unseen objects, a major step toward general-purpose robotic manipulation.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Figure AI announced its Figure 02 humanoid robots have entered full commercial deployment at BMW's Spartanburg plant, performing parts inspection, bin picking, and sub-assembly tasks across multiple shifts. The deployment marks one of the first scaled commercial uses of general-purpose humanoid robots in automotive manufacturing.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Reasoning Traces for Enterprise Compliance and Auditability
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new enterprise feature that exposes structured, human-readable reasoning traces for every Claude response, enabling compliance teams to audit AI decision-making in regulated industries such as finance and healthcare. The feature integrates with existing GRC tooling and addresses a key barrier to enterprise AI adoption around explainability requirements.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm GAA Chips, Powering Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production of its N2 process node using gate-all-around (GAA) transistor architecture, delivering approximately 25% performance improvement and 30% power reduction over its 3nm node. The first customers are expected to be Apple and NVIDIA, with implications for the next generation of AI training and inference hardware.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture Exceeding 1 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth under a permissive license, its largest open-weight model featuring a sparse mixture-of-experts architecture with over 1 trillion total parameters but only ~90B active per forward pass. Benchmarks show competitive performance with proprietary frontier models, intensifying the debate around open vs. closed AI development.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Expanded Brain-Computer Interface Trials in Spinal Cord Injury Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to expand its PRIME clinical trial to include patients with spinal cord injuries, moving beyond ALS patients to test motor intent decoding and digital device control. Early data from existing participants showed stable signal quality over 18 months, addressing durability concerns around implanted neural interfaces.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Next-Gen Atlas with Autonomous Construction Site Navigation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated a new iteration of its electric Atlas humanoid robot autonomously navigating active construction sites, carrying materials up scaffolding, and adapting to dynamic obstacles in real time. The system leverages onboard LiDAR and vision-language models for scene understanding, targeting deployment in hazardous industrial environments by late 2027.
